description: Chief Secretary's Office - S.P. - Published the Southern Province Irrigation Precept
reasoning: This gazette content primarily concerns the establishment of a new legal/regulatory framework - the Southern Province Irrigation Precept. It outlines the creation of a new provincial department, defines its powers and responsibilities, establishes committees, and replaces previous legislation (the Irrigation Ordinance and its amendments). This fits Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory) as it involves new regulations, statutory instruments, and legal provisions rather than focusing on government personnel changes or organizational structure without regulatory content.
